paragraphs.text: Alsoor was one of the twelve Southern City-States during the Dark Age of Terisiare on Dominaria .

Alsoor was an inland city-state, the home of Primata Delphine . In 430 AR , Jodah and Voska were arrested and brought to Alsoor for questioning. Voska sacrificed himself to draw the Church of Tal 's attention away from Jodah, who managed to escape with the help of the Rag Man . Sima later came to the city on the rumor that Voska was still alive, but the rumors had been planted by Delphine, and Sima was arrested. A short time later, Alsoor went into a war against Ghed , resulting in the Battle of Pitdown .
According to Freyalise , Alsoor was troubled by addictive wasting drugs.

At some point afterward, the city of Alsoor would be destroyed by a Diabolic Machine . Its territory would be a part of Kjeldor during the Ice Age (event) . After the Thaw , it would be included in the terrain of New Argive .
